facts.fact: The education ministry's spokesperson says an Early Warning System, now integrated into EMIS, flags individual learners by tracking persistent absenteeism and falling grades and produces a real-time list of learners absent for extended periods; the document does not say who enters the attendance or grades, or where. No date is given, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Education Management Information Systems (EMIS), with its Early Warning System

facts.fact: The ministry's EMIS report counts 39,736 learners who dropped out in 2025, 13,032 at primary and 26,704 at secondary level, and the ministry describes the learner-level Early Warning System in EMIS without limiting it to either level.
